triggers.name: receive_request
triggers.title: New API request
triggers.help: This trigger processes requests from API Platform. Define the request and response definition for the API endpoint.

properties.name: schema_root_type
properties.label: Request structure
properties.hint: The outermost structure of the request body this endpoint accepts — an object { } or an array [ ... ].

properties.name: body
properties.label: Request body
properties.visible_if: (input.request.content_type === 'json') && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_strings' && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_integers' && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_numbers' && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_booleans' && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_dates' && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_date_times' && (input.request.body || !input.request.schema || input.request.schema === '[]')

properties.name: schema
properties.label: Request schema
properties.visible_if: (input.request.content_type === 'json') && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_strings' && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_integers' && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_numbers' && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_booleans' && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_dates' && input.request.schema_root_type !== 'array_of_date_times' && (!(input.request.body || !input.request.schema || input.request.schema === '[]'))
properties.hint: This legacy field is deprecated. Use Request body for new configurations.

properties.name: body_schema_root_type
properties.label: Response structure
properties.hint: The outermost structure of the payload this endpoint returns — an object { } or an array [ ... ].

properties.name: body_schema
properties.label: Response schema
properties.visible_if: (input.response.content_type === 'json') && parentInput.body_schema_root_type !== 'array_of_strings' && parentInput.body_schema_root_type !== 'array_of_integers' && parentInput.body_schema_root_type !== 'array_of_numbers' && parentInput.body_schema_root_type !== 'array_of_booleans' && parentInput.body_schema_root_type !== 'array_of_dates' && parentInput.body_schema_root_type !== 'array_of_date_times'

triggers.name: receive_soap_request
triggers.title: New SOAP request
triggers.help: To use this trigger, import a WSDL. SOAP endpoints can't be built from scratch. Workato generates the request and response schema from the WSDL and processes incoming SOAP requests from API Platform.

actions.name: return_response
actions.title: Respond to API request
actions.help: Return data to the API client. Select a response code defined in the trigger and provide data for the relevant fields. A job will stop immediately after this action.

actions.name: return_soap_response
actions.title: Respond to SOAP API request
actions.help: Return SOAP data to the API client. Select a response code defined in the trigger and provide data for the relevant fields. A job will stop immediately after this action.
